name: Article 4 – § 1 – point 2 – point a Regulation (EU) No 181/2011 – Article 20 – after § 1 – 176
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EC) No 261/2004, (EC) No 1107/2006, (EU) No 1177/2010, (EU) No 181/2011 and (EU) 2021/782 as regards enforcement of passenger rights in the Union
part_text: 1a. Carriers which are micro, small or medium-sized enterprises within the meaning of Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC may fulfil the obligation under paragraph 1 to inform passengers of their passenger rights by means of a clearly visible notice at the terminal or by referring passengers, on the ticket or by electronic means, to that information on their website. Such carriers shall provide the information referred to in paragraph 4 as soon as possible, without being bound by the time limit laid down in paragraph 1.
